类 ProgressBar

java.lang.Object
cn.msscn.progress.ProgressBar
所有已实现的接口:
ProgressReporter, AutoCloseable
public final class ProgressBar extends Object implements ProgressReporter, AutoCloseable
A single progress task.

Three ways to use it:

  1. Console/log rendering: just call update(double); refresh is throttled.
  2. Pure API: configure NoopSink and poll getValue()/getPercent().
  3. Async: attach a ProgressListener or wait on future().

Mutation methods are synchronized, so several producer threads may update the same bar safely. Snapshots handed to callbacks are immutable.
